result.title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
result.summary: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational autoencoder that encodes a design into one shared spatial prototype and one candidate vector per layer. Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its corresponding RGBA layer. For $N$ layers, the representation contains $HW+N$ tokens before backbone-specific packing, compared with $NHW$ for full-grid-per-layer representations. ProtoDiffusion jointly denoises the prototype and a fixed set of candidate slots, conditioned on an image or text, with bounding boxes as optional layout guidance. The model leaves unneeded slots empty and determines the number of layers and, in absence of boxes, their layout, requiring neither as input. The same architecture supports both image-to-design and text-to-design. ProtoVAE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction from its compact shared latent representation, reaching 40.43 dB PSNR on layer crops. On the LayerD evaluation split, image-to-design achieves RGB L1 scores of 0.040 with bounding boxes and 0.057 without, with box-guided alpha soft IoU (0.850) comparable to the strongest fine-tuned baseline (0.871). On merged images, text-to-design reaches 66.41 FID versus 86.84 for FLUX.2 [klein], achieves a 0.860 text-accuracy score, and runs $19.1\times$ faster than the same-backbone generation-then-decomposition cascade.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ProtoDiffusion：以多层 VAE（ProtoVAE）把一个分层设计编码为一份共享空间 prototype 加每层一个候选向量，再对该紧凑表示做 latent diffusion 联合去噪，支持图像或文本生成分层图像并自行决定层数与布局。
AI.relevance_reason: 「共享 prototype + 每层候选槽」的紧凑 latent 表示与空槽/变槽数机制，可能为 LVR 中压缩视觉细节、按需分配多个候选槽（证据或假设）提供表示与容量分配线索，可供核查。
